en: A vintage black-and-white image featuring a railway station building surrounded by trees. The structure has a traditional design, with brick walls, a sloped roof, and several chimneys. The station name 'HASSELFORS' is visible above the main entrance. There are visible advertisements on the building, and railway tracks run in the foreground. The top right corner contains the printed title 'Hasselfors station.'
